lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Four names in both columns. They declared an interest in a perpetual counterparty in 2031, they signed the Handover instruments in 2064, and in every year between they declared it again, correctly, on the form, on time.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: It was never hidden. That is what I keep walking into. None of this was concealed from anyone — it was filed, and filing a thing is how you make it disappear without ever lying about it.

lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Take the gallery pass. Seat forty-one, third reading. Issued to somebody who did not come, which is most of them.
